dnsRecords.name: store
dnsRecords.comment: Coastal Key Store — Cloudflare Pages custom domain

provisioning: Automated via .github/workflows/deploy.yml (deploy-store job). On every push to main, CI attaches the custom domain to the ck-store Pages project and creates the proxied CNAME store -> ck-store.pages.dev using CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Idempotent — safe to re-run.

steps: 1. Push to main triggers the deploy-store CI job which provisions the domain + DNS automatically
2. Wait for SSL certificate provisioning (usually < 5 minutes after first attach)
3. Verify https://store.coastalkey-pm.com loads the enrollment page
4. Manual fallback: dash.cloudflare.com > Pages > ck-store > Custom domains > add store.coastalkey-pm.com
